description: This file defines the ApplyChecksumMiddleware class, which is a middleware component for AWS S3 SDK. It handles applying necessary or optional checksum headers (like MD5, SHA256, or CRC32) to requests before they are sent to S3, ensuring data integrity and compliance with AWS requirements.

classes.name: ApplyChecksumMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware to apply required or optional checksum headers to S3 requests, supporting algorithms like MD5, SHA256, and CRC32. It ensures proper checksum headers are added based on operation and configuration.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a wrapper function that adds checksum middleware to a given service API.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with the next handler and the AWS service API.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main middleware method that inspects the command and request, and adds checksum headers as needed based on operation and parameters.

methods.name: addAlgorithmHeader
methods.description: Adds a checksum algorithm header (e.g., x-amz-checksum-sha256) with the encoded checksum value to the request.

methods.name: isS3Express
methods.description: Checks whether the command is for the s3express signing service, used to determine checksum handling logic.
